tierSystemNote: Asilia's own tier system (RSP=rack, Standard, Gold, Silver, Bronze) is NOT the same as Soroi's STO ladder or A&K's flat %. Verified arithmetically: 'Standard' = RSP x 0.75 exactly (25% off rack, matching the 'Agent Discount 0.25' cell in the workbook). 'RSP-Gold' duplicates 'Standard' exactly (i.e. Gold's starting point IS the Standard/25%-off rate); 'Gold' = RSP-Gold x 0.75 (a further 25% off, ~43.75% off rack total). 'RSP-Silver' sits at roughly 15% off rack, then 'Silver' = RSP-Silver x 0.75. 'RSP-Bronze' sits at roughly 7% off rack, then 'Bronze' = RSP-Bronze x 0.75. Which named tier (Standard/Gold/Silver/Bronze) applies to Sunworld specifically is NOT stated anywhere in the workbook - confirm with Asilia/Sunworld contracting before quoting a specific tier.
